# External Mobile Telemetry POC
Operational telemetry and governed business events are intentionally separated.

content.query: union isfuzzy=true AppRequests, AppDependencies, AppExceptions | where TimeGenerated >= ago(2h) | summarize Count=count() by Type, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Operational telemetry

content.query: ExternalMobileEvents_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(2h) | summarize Count=count() by EventType, Outcome
content.title: Governed business events
